summary: Electrovaya Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, containing a corporate presentation as Exhibit 99.1. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report with no disclosure of any special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The corporate presentation appears to be for general investor relations purposes. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special situation and is classified as None.
